svg.title: D3 Loadings: the two faces of a mode
svg.desc: A mode ψ_i is a function on sites (left) and, through its loading a_i = (H^L)^T ψ_i, a direction in activation space (right) [thm]. Over a complete orthonormal basis, constant mode included, H^L = Σ_i ψ_i a_i^T exactly; dropping modes costs Σ_{i>r} ‖a_i‖^2.
